package.name: aav_ndt
package.description: NDT in Rust (rclrs), a trial: where the car is on a saved lidar map (maps/ndt/*.pcd, made by tools/ndt_map.py), in x, y and yaw. /sensors/lidar/points and /localization/odom/local in; /localization/ndt/pose and /localization/ndt/status out. Never TF; nothing drives by it until it wins the trials (docs/designs/2026-10-29_ndt.md). The maths is the ndt-core crate, with no ROS.
